newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic says May gold mine output rises.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic says May gold mine output rises.

text.p: Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Tuesday combined group attributable gold output in May from its six separate mines in Western Australia totalled 52,199 ounces, the highest level ever for the company.
Output from the main Plutonic mine reached a near-record 30,173 ounces, second only to December 1990 when the miner had better access to high-grade shallow laterite ore, Plutonic said.
Group attributable gold production for the first five months of 1997 of 214,399 ounces is an increase of 37 percent over the 156,752 oz produced for the equivalent period of 1996, the company said.

Plutonic Resources said it was releasing updated figures to the Australian Stock Exchange prior to a presentation by its managing director Ronald Hawkes at the European Gold Mining Investment Forum in Geneva later on Tuesday.
The last reported figures were for the March quarter.
Plutonic is about 32 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd.
